verified_facts.text: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito at Bvlgari Hotel Paris is led by Chef Niko Romito.
verified_facts.excerpt: With the three-Michelin-starred Chef Niko Romito at the helm, every element of the restaurant is handpicked to create an intimate and enchanting dining experience.

verified_facts.text: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito is hidden in a private garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: the restaurant is hidden in a private garden, making for a luminous, sparkling atmosphere any time of day

verified_facts.text: The Bvlgari Spa is open to hotel residents and local clients.

verified_facts.text: The Bvlgari Spa is clad in Vicenza stone from Veneto, Italy, and Burmese teak.

verified_facts.text: The Spa Suite is designed for couples and has two treatment tables, a private hydromassage and a hammam.
verified_facts.excerpt: Created for couples, it features two treatment tables, private hydromassage and hammam ensconced in perfectly symmetrical book-matched green onyx.

verified_facts.text: The Spa Suite design is inspired by the Dome of the Roman Pantheon.
verified_facts.excerpt: the design of which is inspired by the Dome of the Roman Pantheon

verified_facts.text: Each spa treatment room has its own shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nine treatment rooms, each one decorated with Vicenza stone come with their own shower for the ultimate privacy and care.

verified_facts.text: The pool is lined with emerald, jade and malachite mosaics rippled with gold.
verified_facts.excerpt: is lined with mosaics in myriad shades of emerald, jade and malachite, rippled with gold

verified_facts.text: The fitness space is open around the clock and curated by Workshop Gymnasium.
verified_facts.excerpt: Open 24/7, the 120-square-metre Fitness Space is curated by Workshop Gymnasium

verified_facts.text: The Bvlgari Bar has black granite floors, a high-gloss ceiling and brass accents.
verified_facts.excerpt: Black granite floors, high-gloss ceiling and brass accents conjure contemporary sophistication and savoir faire

verified_facts.text: The Bvlgari Bar serves aperitivo in the classic Italian way, with bites and antipasti.

verified_facts.text: The private dining room is furnished entirely with Antonio Citterio designs and sits next to the garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Entirely furnished by Antonio Citterio design, the eight-seat private dining room can be reserved for special occasions and intimate dinner parties. Located next to the garden

verified_facts.text: The Bvlgari Lounge has marble tables and serves Afternoon Tea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set with marble tables, the Lounge is the ideal location to leaf through a book, relax, or meet with friends and colleagues over a drink, tea or light snack.

verified_facts.text: The spa reception is finished in green onyx.
